filters: rated Standard games, excluding source-marked bots, completed results only
numerator: count of eligible games with result 1/2-1/2
denominator: count of eligible games with result in 1-0, 0-1, 1/2-1/2
null_rules: unknown results excluded and counted; empty denominator yields null
caveats: Historical foundation corpus is not evidence about contemporary players.
Excluding marked bots does not establish all other players are human.
No opening, time-pressure, or causal claims are supported by this metric.
